carbs.source_notes: Official raw farmed Atlantic salmon value is 0 g/100g, calculated from imputed zero sugar and starch. Dutch raw salmon entry also reports 0.0 g. Supported estimate, not a measured absence; generic salmon species/farming is unspecified.

vitamin_d.source_definition: Vitamin D as reported by Matvaretabellen; analytical mean, source 321f (Institute of Marine Research seafood data, 2022). Chemical subform detail is not given on the food page.
vitamin_d.source_notes: Raw farmed Atlantic salmon: 7 ug/100g. V2 accepts the reported ordinary Vitamin D value. Dutch raw salmon cross-check is 9 ug/100g; retain primary value. Species, feed and farming affect transfer to unspecified generic salmon.

omega_3.source_definition: Total cis n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids, calculated as the sum of cis n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids; source 321f.
omega_3.source_notes: Official reported total is 2.6 g/100g for raw farmed Atlantic salmon. Use the published total, not a new EPA+DHA sum. Generic salmon origin and farming are unspecified, so review applicability.

vitamin_k.source_definition: Study-defined total of phylloquinone and menaquinones MK-4 to MK-10, expressed as phylloquinone equivalents (PKeq), adjusted for molecular weight; not unweighted vitamer mass.
vitamin_k.source_notes: Approximate 17 ug PKeq/100g read visually from the complete stacked Salmon, raw bar in Fig. 6 of Jensen et al. (2025). Range 16-18 reflects graph-reading uncertainty, not population variation. Raw farmed Salmo salar; exact numeric supplement unavailable. V2 common food value; explicit review needed for PKeq basis and generic-food transfer.

references.title: Jensen et al. (2025): Vitamin K - content in food and dietary intake among the Danes
references.locator: Fig. 6, printed p. 6 (PDF p. 7), Salmon, raw; sections 3.2.3 and 4 explain food match and PKeq total
